title: Parts of a Plant
seo_title: Year 1 Science: Parts of a Plant Worksheets (Roots, Stem, Leaves, Flowers)
standard_text: Identify and describe the basic structure of a variety of common flowering plants, including trees.
meta_desc: Free Year 1 science worksheets on the parts of a plant: roots, stem, leaves, flowers, seeds and fruit, the parts of a tree and plant parts we eat. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: A tree trunk is a stem. Roots are under the soil.
body_html:
How to think about it

Plants have roots, a stem, leaves and flowers.

  • Roots are under the soil.
  • Leaves grow on the stem.
  • A tree trunk is a big, woody stem.
Example

Which part is under the soil?

It grows down

Answer: the roots

Example

A tree's thick stem is called?

Woody

Answer: the trunk

Common mistakes

  • Thinking roots grow above the ground.
  • Thinking a tree trunk is not a stem.
  • Thinking all leaves are the same shape.

faq.q: What are the parts of a plant?
faq.a: Roots, a stem, leaves and flowers. Many plants also have seeds and fruits.

faq.q: Does a tree have the same parts?
faq.a: Yes. A tree has roots, a trunk (a big, woody stem), branches, leaves and often blossom (flowers).

faq.q: Which parts of plants do we eat?
faq.a: Carrots are roots, lettuce is leaves, celery is a stem, broccoli is flowers, peas are seeds and apples are fruits.
